name: Creative QA
description: Source-agnostic creative QA for ad assets (video and static). Setup interviews the team in plain questions to learn their review process, naming convention, and routing; the review skill runs deterministic checks first and rubric-based AI checks second; the calibration loop backtests on past assets and refines the rubric from reviewer feedback every 10 signals toward 90-100% agreement. Works with any intake platform (Slack, Asana, Frame.io, Notion, Drive links, direct upload) and any feedback destination. Available only through an explicit package install; installation only delivers files, and setup waits for explicit human approval before integration connections, routine creation, or writes to external tools.
